use_when: when the meaning of the action matters as much as the action itself.
Use Default (solid) for the main action and Two-Tone for a quieter option beside it
Pair a semantic button with an Outline button for the safe choice, such as Cancel next to Delete.
Negative: delete, remove or hard to undo (Figma semantic-button colour meaning; this component is the Button / Destructive node).

dont_use_when.when: for everyday actions. If everything has a color, nothing stands out.
Do not put more than one semantic color in the same group of buttons.
Do not choose a color because it looks nice.

best_practice: Match the label to the color: "Delete account" for Negative, "Confirm order" for Positive.
Add an icon when it helps people understand the meaning faster.

variant_intent.type=Default: Figma semantic buttons: Default (solid) for the main action.
variant_intent.type=Outline: Renders the outline style (code). Figma names the quieter option Two-Tone, not Outline.
variant_intent.shape=Rounded: Renders the rounded shape. Figma: do not mix Rounded and Pill shapes on one screen.
variant_intent.shape=Pill: Renders the pill shape. Figma: do not mix Rounded and Pill shapes on one screen.
variant_intent.iconStyle=leading icon: Renders an icon before the label.
variant_intent.iconStyle=trailing icon: Renders an icon after the label.
variant_intent.iconStyle=Both icons: Renders an icon before and after the label.
variant_intent.iconStyle=Icon only: Renders the icon alone; labelText becomes the accessible name. Figma: use icon-only buttons only for icons that are easy to recognize.
variant_intent.state=Default: Lets hover, press and focus happen naturally (code).
variant_intent.state=Hover: Pins the hover look, for docs and QA (code).
variant_intent.state=Press: Pins the pressed look, for docs and QA (code).
variant_intent.state=Focus: Pins the focus look, for docs and QA (code).
variant_intent.state=Disable: Disables the button. Figma: use Disabled only when the action is temporarily unavailable.

a11y.fact: Composes Button, so it renders a native <button> that takes keyboard focus.
Native <button> element, disabled natively when disabled.
An icon-only button gets aria-label from labelText unless aria-label is passed.
